summary.text: Dennis Breen is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Frank Iler (R). He is a lawyer who has practiced for 45 years.

paragraphs.text: Dennis Breen earned a high school diploma from Saint Francis Preparatory School, a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York at Brockport in 1973, a graduate degree from SUNY Binghamton in 1977, and a law degree from the University of Dayton School of Law in 1982.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Brooklyn, New York, and is a lawyer admitted in North Carolina and New York.
Breen advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, which was canceled.

In the survey, he listed three campaign messages: controlling development so that infrastructure, schools and drainage keep pace with growth; clean and safe drinking water through cooperation among state, local and federal government; and affordable housing and planned growth.
He also said he is passionate about reducing the role of money in politics.
